newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen higher at open, helped by bonds.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen higher at open, helped by bonds.

text.p: U.S. stocks were expected to open firmer on Friday, helped by a rising bond market ahead of next week's meeting of Federal Reserve policy makers.
"With the bond market developing a bid to it overnight, the stock market should open on a firmer tone," said Charles White, managing director of Avatar Associates.
The Standard & Poor's 500 futures index was up 3.20 points at 897.70. The long bond, whose jitters have recently haunted the stock market, rose 9/32 at a 6.76 percent yield.
Markets awaited the University of Michigan consumer confidence index for June, forecast at a 103.5 reading.
